optimization_mode.description: Optional latency/quality trade-off. 'latency' returns faster by replacing the creative decision model with a deterministic, contrast-verified layout; 'quality' currently behaves like the default and is reserved for the quality-optimized path. Omit for default behavior.

safe_zone.title: Safe Zone
safe_zone.description: Optional JSON array [y_min, y_max] (fractions of video height, 0-1) that the overlay must be fully contained in — e.g. [0.1, 0.6] keeps the overlay out of the top 10% and bottom 40%.
